zh: 热那亚大学（，简称Università di Genova和UniGe），意大利热那亚的一所大学. 该校成立于1481年. 学生人数约4万人，是意大利最大的国立大学之一.
早在 13 世纪，热那亚当地就即有学院，授予法律、神学、医学和艺术学位. 但神学院迟至 1471 年才正式成立，医学院于1481 年章程也正式颁布.
1569 年，根据热那亚共和国参议院的法令，这些既有的学院并入耶稣会所开办的学校. 耶稣会购买土地扩大校地，以容纳持续扩充的学院. 这批新校地上的建筑，也就是当前热那亚大学的主要校舍，由建筑师 Bartolomeo Bianco 设计，于 1640 年开始使用.
1773 年耶稣会受到镇压，各种学习课程进行重组，教授初级教育：修辞学、读写课程，另在高等教育领域则开办：教规、哲学、民法、神学、逻辑学、物理学. 至19世纪初，法兰西帝国并吞热那亚共和国后，热那亚大学改隶属法国巴黎帝国大学. 此时，高等教育再被细分为不同专业：法学、医学、物理和数学，同时也有商业、语言、文学、化学. 热那亚大学于 1812 年恢复为独立的大学.
拿破仑倒台后，1815年维也纳会议上，热那亚大学被委托交付给撒丁王国，享有杜林大学同等的自治权. 其后由于政治动乱， 1821 - 1823 年， 1830 - 1835 年，热那亚大学两度关闭.
en: The University of Genoa (, abbreviated as UniGe ), is a public research university. It is one of the largest universities in Italy and it is located in the city of Genoa, on the Italian Riviera in the Liguria region of northwestern Italy. The original university was founded in 1481.
The University of Genoa is organized in several independent campuses located in different city areas:

* The Balbi campus: includes the Rectorate, the central administration offices, the departments of Economics, Humanities, Philosophy, Languages, Law and Political Science; * The Sarzano campus: includes the departments of Education Sciences and Architecture; * The Albaro campus: comprises the departments of Engineering; * The Valletta Puggia campus: comprises the Departments of Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry; * The San Martino campus: comprises the Departments of Medicine and Earth Sciences;

Of great historical and artistic interest are the buildings in Via Balbi and in particular: the main university premises (via Balbi, 5) designed by the architect Bartolomeo Bianco and built in 1640, Palazzo Balbi Cattaneo (via Balbi, 2), and Palazzo Balbi Senarega (via Balbi, 4). Also of major historical interest is the complex of Albergo dei Poveri (piazza Emanuele Brignole).
The university's botanical garden, the Orto Botanico dell'Università di Genova, occupies one hectare in the city center, just above the university's main building.
